why: The SHIPPED movement wired end to end and moving by nothing: the rule applies unconditionally, the animation is named, the duration and easing come from the tokens, and the content sits exactly where it will end up. That is issue #542 undone in one number, back to the crossfade the owner said they had never seen in action -- and back with no flag to reveal it, since this is the default now rather than an arm nobody selects. Invisible to every other check here: jsdom computes no animated value, so only the DECLARATION can be read, which is why the case that measures it matches the `from` step's transform against every identity spelling and carries those spellings as its own negative control. 16px was chosen off rendered frames precisely because a distance that is too small stops reading as travel; zero is that failure taken to its limit.
killedBy: menu transitions in hud.css gives each movement its keyframes, moving for real and ending at no transform at all
